info.title: Cloudify
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic. Cloudify is an open-source cloud orchestration platform for modeling, deploying, and managing multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure and applications through TOSCA-based blueprints.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 26 of 95 upstream operations covering Blueprints, Deployments, Executions, Nodes, Node Instances, Secrets, Events, and Status. Excluded: Deployment/Plugin update workflows, Plugins, Snapshots, Sites, Tenants, Users, User Groups, Managers, License, Agents, Task Graphs, and Summary reporting -- all manager/cluster administration or niche plumbing outside common blueprint/deployment/execution CRUD automation. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
